subject: template metaprograms for primitives, var, and fvar

messages.author: cab04b8f0759c712
messages.subject: template metaprograms for primitives, var, and fvar
parts:
I'm starting to run into some problems with our template metaprograms and how everything is tied together. As of right now, stan/meta/traits.hpp pulls in stan/agrad/rev/var.hpp and stan/agrad/fwd/fvar.hpp, so essentially, everything gets pulled in.

I think the right thing to do is to try to define the base template function in stan/meta/traits.hpp (or even stan/meta/traits/___.hpp), and have var.hpp and fvar.hpp include that as well as a specialization for var or fvar. I guess if we have a generic specialization that can cover both, we could define it at the stan/agrad/ level.

Thoughts? Behavior should be identical to now, the code would need to be rearranged for this to work.



Daniel

Yes, I think we should disentangle this for the next
release exactly in the way you suggest.

We should also break out things that aren't technically
traits the way the other classes and functions are broken out.

Can't we just pull in var and fvar definitions rather
than all of var.hpp and fvar.hpp?

I'm going to submit a pull request soon for some
function-definition by simple functor classes that'll
let us easily define new special functions for arithmetic
types, var, and fvar, including vectorization, and I plan
to organize them the same way.

- Bob
